dedupe_keys.name: storenet dingle energy community measurements and scripts

description: The StoreNet consortium publishes 2020 measurements from 20 homes in Dingle, Ireland. Every participating home had a 3.3-kW, 10-kWh residential battery, and ten also had 2.4-kW rooftop photovoltaic systems. The collection contains household power and energy tables, battery state, photovoltaic output, grid exchanges, weather observations and Python processing examples. Its 46 Figshare deposits are public and free under CC0. One-minute observations can calibrate household dispatch and energy-community simulations alongside model-pypsa or model-energyplus. A caveat is that this demonstration community is not a representative national demand sample. Consistent time zones, units and missing measurements need checking before aggregation. The README contains conflicting software licence badges, so code users should retain the deposit terms and investigate that ambiguity. No measurement files or scripts were run.
